origin-office 1.0.0

- Initial release: Convert native docx/pptx files into verifiable structured objects.
- Zero-dependency parser: Supports chapters, articles, paragraphs, tables (with merged cells and checkboxes) for docx; slides, shapes (with placeholder types), and tables (with gridSpan merged) for pptx.
- Each structure element becomes an object with a SHA-256 fingerprint for integrity verification.
- CLI tools: Import, inspect structure, build/export structured packages, verify consistency, and export to markdown/JSON.
- Enables reliable structure extraction and change tracking—different from error-prone OCR or PDF-based workflows.
- Use cases: AI-anchorable, verifiable document structures, version tracking, clause-level referencing.
